interpretation: Native use requires an enabled configured/registered MCP server and applicable trust/exposure/session/operator gates. BASE Jouzu deferred MCP extension rewrites codemode exposure to deferred and disables autoEnableCodemode; standalone native CLI/direct SDK uses its own setup. Importing this package alone opens no connection or authorization. McpClient request/validation failure rejects API promise. Native McpServerConnection may retry transient read-only/session-expired failures, replace auth-required with sign-in guidance, or wrap failed connect and captured stdio tail. Tool/resource callers can convert rejection to tool result through AgentCore; policy/extensions/renderers can replace/suppress/truncate before session persistence/paint. Direct SDK caller decides reporting. Transport/client emitError is report-only and does not itself reject pending requests. Native McpServerConnection registers notifications and onClose but no McpClient.onError listener, so no direct native display of this report is established. SDK onError subscribers can receive it. Pending request can later fail with timeout/close or a separate send failure; error listener throwing is not caught by emitError. OAuth helper promise rejects/throws to caller. Native proactive refresh suppresses failures and tries old token; unauthorized recovery can replace auth-required errors with sign-in state/guidance. Interactive native sign-in or native MCP CLI can report final error; abort/finally/callback-close failures may replace it.
